claims.text: The preserved source explicitly asks for the length of the maximum substring without repeated characters and requires a sliding-window implementation; Java null handling and UTF-16 code-unit semantics are candidate contracts.
The candidate advances the left boundary to max(left, previousIndex + 1), preserving a duplicate-free current window while preventing the boundary from moving backward.

The checked-in validator compares the sliding-window implementation with brute-force contiguous-substring enumeration across deterministic cases including abba, exhaustive small strings, and seeded randomized UTF-16 code-unit strings.
